title: Librar Labs: The AI librarian
tagline: AI librarian saving library staff hundreds of hours and doubling student reading rates.
body:
The reading rates have hit an all time low. That’s why Librar Labs built the AI librarian that can do the busywork saving the library staff hundreds of hours and more than doubling reading rates.\
\
Librar is built on a uniqe self healing database infrastructure, that is transforming how AI can navigate the digital world of literature. This powerful technology is now used to more than double reading rates for the hundreds of paying schools of Librar, and is being adopted at a pace never seen before in publishing, library and archive tech history.\
\
The team of quantum physicists, exited founders and dropouts are backed by founders and operators from OpenAI, Depict, Kahoot, Google Maps and many more to tackle the one of the greatest problems of our time.\
\
